alerts.name: o2_alert_evaluation_failures
alerts.description: An alert's own evaluation query failed (query error or timeout). Silent alert coverage loss: the alert is scheduled but is not actually checking anything.

query_condition.sql: SELECT _timestamp, org, "key", error FROM "triggers" WHERE org = '{org_id}' AND module = 'alert' AND status = 'error'

alerts.name: o2_alert_notification_failures
alerts.description: An alert condition matched but the notification could not be delivered. Without this, a webhook or SMTP outage silently swallows every firing.

query_condition.sql: SELECT _timestamp, org, "key", error FROM "triggers" WHERE org = '{org_id}' AND module = 'alert' AND status = 'notify_failed' AND "key" NOT LIKE 'o2_alert_notification_failures/%'

alerts.name: o2_scheduler_job_backlog
alerts.description: Scheduled jobs are running well after their due time, so alerts and reports are evaluating on stale windows.

query_condition.sql: SELECT _timestamp, org, module, "key", delay_in_secs FROM "triggers" WHERE org = '{org_id}' AND delay_in_secs > 300
